notes: ERR-052 through ERR-054 are from May 2 session — postprocessor and pipeline fixes. ERR-067 is from May 8 session — fixed bare chapter numeral heading format. ERR-070/071 from May 24 — chapter 4 partial completion fixes.

errors.trigger: Ollama response exceeds 300s timeout
errors.solution: Reduce chunk size by 20% (e.g., 1500→1200 chars) and retry
errors.prevention: Set chunk_size ≤ 1200 for models ≤ 7B parameters

errors.trigger: Myanmar char ratio < 70% after 3 retries — model translates idioms to English explanation instead
errors.solution: Add to retry prompt: 'Do NOT explain. Translate the FEELING into Myanmar metaphor.'
errors.prevention: Include this instruction in base system prompt for Stage 1

errors.trigger: Model uses phonetic variant not in glossary
errors.solution: Add variant as alias in glossary.json. Re-run postprocessor on saved file.
errors.prevention: Inject glossary with strict instruction: 'Use EXACTLY these spellings. No variants.'

errors.trigger: Model outputs Bengali Unicode characters (U+0980–U+09FF) inside Myanmar text
errors.solution: Run postprocessor regex to strip U+0980–U+09FF range. Flag chunk for re-translation.
errors.prevention: Add to system prompt: 'Bengali script (U+0980–U+09FF) is STRICTLY FORBIDDEN. Myanmar Unicode only.'

errors.trigger: chunk_overlap > 0 causes the same sentence at end of chunk N and start of chunk N+1
errors.solution: Set chunk_overlap=0 in Chunker. Add boundary deduplication in postprocessor before saving.
errors.prevention: Chunker must split on paragraph boundaries only, never mid-paragraph by character count

errors.trigger: Ollama crashes with out-of-memory on large chapters (> 2000 chars per chunk)
errors.solution: Switch to smaller model (qwen:7b) for this chapter. Reduce chunk_size to 800.
errors.prevention: Monitor GPU VRAM — if < 2GB free before chapter start, use qwen:7b automatically

errors.trigger: Archaic words သင်သည် / ဤ / ထို appear in Myanmar output instead of modern equivalents
errors.solution: Add to retry prompt: 'Use modern storytelling words: မင်း / ဒီ / အဲဒီ. Never use သင်သည်, ဤ, ထို.'
errors.prevention: Add STRICT RULE to Editor (Stage 2) system prompt: avoid archaic words

errors.trigger: Same Myanmar particle (သည်/ကို/မှာ/၏) appears > 2× per paragraph — hallucination loop
errors.solution: Run postprocessor particle repetition detector. Re-translate chunk with repeat_penalty increased by 0.1.
errors.prevention: Use repeat_penalty ≥ 1.15 in sampling params. Add particle diversity rule to Editor prompt.

errors.trigger: 【?term?】 placeholder tokens are guessed/resolved by model instead of preserved
errors.solution: Run postprocessor to detect missing placeholders. Re-translate with stronger instruction: 'Never guess 【?term?】 — preserve exactly.'
errors.prevention: Add to ALL agent system prompts: '【?term?】 tokens must be preserved verbatim. Never resolve or guess.'

errors.trigger: Pronoun hierarchy violation — မင်း/ရှင်/ကျွန်တော် used incorrectly for character status
errors.solution: Re-translate dialogue sections with explicit character status context (senior/junior/equal).
errors.prevention: Pass active_characters from context_memory.json with status hierarchy to prompt.

errors.trigger: Chinese SVO word order survives into Myanmar SOV output (verb before object)
errors.solution: Re-translate with explicit SVO→SOV instruction. Flag sentences where object appears after verb.
errors.prevention: Add SVO→SOV conversion rule as first instruction in all translator prompts.

errors.trigger: Chapter file naming convention mismatch — code only looks for {chapter:03d}.md but files use varied naming
errors.solution: Add _find_chapter_file() with 5 naming patterns and _discover_chapters() with regex fallback
errors.prevention: Support multiple file naming conventions in chapter discovery

errors.trigger: Multiple quality issues: Bengali leak, duplication, metadata in body, register mix, heading format, emotional intensity
errors.solution: Comprehensive fix across 6 files: postprocessor, preprocessor, translator, quality_checker, orchestrator, settings
errors.prevention: Run full quality audit on output before marking chapter done

errors.trigger: Preprocessor.detect_language() returns 'unknown' for text < 50 chars
errors.solution: Ensure test inputs exceed 50-char minimum length
errors.prevention: Document minimum input length requirement for auto-detection

errors.trigger: remove_latin_words regex r'\s+' collapses all whitespace including newlines
errors.solution: Change regex to r'[^\S\n]+' to only collapse horizontal whitespace
errors.prevention: Always test postprocessor with multi-paragraph input

errors.trigger: Orchestrator passes wrong parameters to agent constructors
errors.solution: Match constructor signatures exactly — check agent __init__ before passing params from orchestrator
errors.prevention: All agents should have consistent constructor patterns. Test full pipeline initialization.

errors.trigger: padauk-gemma model outputs word-by-word glossary comparison lines (*:* "word" is . "other" is .) in translation output
errors.solution: Add postprocessor patterns for *:* lines with English comparison words. Add line-level *:* detection in strip_reasoning_process().
errors.prevention: Keep padauk-gemma temperature ≤ 0.2 to reduce hallucinations. Add anti-glossary-comparison instruction to translator prompt.

errors.trigger: remove_duplicate_headings() uses exact string match but headings vary slightly between chunks (different title text, with/without subtitle)
errors.solution: Use prefix matching on '# အခန်း N' pattern instead of exact string comparison. Reset in_duplicate_block flag when new chapter heading encountered.
errors.prevention: Always test deduplication with varied heading formats including minor character differences.

errors.trigger: Orchestrator _preprocess() calls clean_markdown() but NOT strip_metadata(). Credit lines (Translator: X Editor: Y) survive into chunks and get translated into output body.
errors.solution: Add strip_metadata() call in orchestrator _preprocess() before clean_markdown(). Add strip_translated_metadata() postprocessor as defense-in-depth for translated credit lines.
errors.prevention: Always strip metadata BEFORE chunking, not after. Test with source files containing Translator:/Editor: lines.

errors.trigger: replace_archaic_words() using python \b regex matches Myanmar combining marks (Mn) as \W, creating false word boundaries inside compounds like ထိုင်ခိုင်း
errors.solution: Use Myanmar consonant lookahead/lookbehind: (?<![က-အ])WORD(?!combining*[က-အ]). Add undo_archaic_corruptions() to fix pre-existing corruptions.
errors.prevention: NEVER use \b with Myanmar text. Use Myanmar-specific consonant boundaries.

errors.trigger: Tamil or other Indic scripts (U+0B80-U+0DFF) appear in Myanmar output — not caught by existing Chinese/Bengali/Thai detection
errors.solution: Add _INDIC_PATTERN covering 9 Indic script blocks. Strip in clean_output() unconditionally. Add to detect_language_leakage() and validate_output().
errors.prevention: Always strip ALL non-Myanmar scripts unconditionally — no script other than Myanmar should appear in output.

errors.trigger: _check_paragraph_duplication() using char-set overlap detects false duplicates on Myanmar sentences sharing common particles (သည်/ကို/မည်) — different sentences show 81-86% overlap
errors.solution: Replace char-set overlap with SequenceMatcher(None, p1, p2).ratio() for sequence similarity. Threshold 0.85+ is safe for true chunk-boundary duplicates.
errors.prevention: NEVER use char-set overlap for Myanmar sentence similarity. SequenceMatcher (sequence-based) is the correct algorithm for detecting duplicate Myanmar text.

errors.trigger: _check_sentence_enders() does not accept ! and ? as valid enders, and counts section-subtitle lines between --- separators as unended content lines
errors.solution: Add '!' and '?' to valid_enders tuple. Detect subtitle lines (lone non-heading lines following --- separator) and exclude from content_lines check.
errors.prevention: Myanmar modern prose regularly uses ! and ?. Chapter format may include ---\n<subtitle>\n--- sections. Both must be handled.

errors.trigger: Korean Hangul characters (U+AC00-U+D7FF) appear in Myanmar output for untranslated terms (e.g. 괴물 = monster)
errors.solution: Postprocessor _check_foreign_scripts() already detects Korean. If found in output file, replace with Myanmar equivalent manually or re-translate chunk.
errors.prevention: Korean leakage is rare. Quality gate won't block 2 stray characters if overall ratio passes. Consider adding Korean to postprocessor strip list.

errors.trigger: Model outputs English garbage (URL fragments, sentence fragments) at end of final chunk — e.g. '– It of .' and '://en..//____'
errors.solution: Remove garbage lines from output file manually. The overall Myanmar ratio quality gate (>70%) will catch severe cases but may miss 2-3 garbage lines if rest of chapter is good.
errors.prevention: Consider adding a per-chunk English word count detector: if last chunk has >5 English words and <80% Myanmar, flag for review before assembling.

errors.trigger: Translation output missing proper Myanmar chapter heading format (# အခန်း N)
errors.solution: Postprocessor must inject proper heading. If missing, add fix in postprocessor.clean_output(). For existing files, run fix_dao_output.py or manually add '# အခန်း N' at start.
errors.prevention: Postprocessor.clean_output() should check for and inject proper chapter heading from filename before saving.

errors.trigger: Chunks 5 and 7 of chapter 003 showed 0% Myanmar ratio after refinement - refiner outputting English instead of Myanmar
errors.solution: Strengthened refiner prompts with explicit Myanmar language guard. Added Myanmar Extended-B range (U+A9E0-U+A9FF) to MYANMAR_PATTERN for proper detection.
errors.prevention: Always include LANGUAGE_GUARD in refiner prompts. MYANMAR_PATTERN must include all 3 Myanmar Unicode blocks: U+1000-U+109F, U+AA60-U+AA7F, U+A9E0-U+A9FF.

errors.trigger: Thai (U+0E00-U+0E7F) and Khmer (U+1780-U+17FF) characters appearing in Myanmar output, along with checkbox artifacts (- [○], - []:) and markdown headers with English text (## [ in ])
errors.solution: Added KHMER_PATTERN to postprocessor_patterns.py. Added remove_thai_characters() and remove_khmer_characters() to postprocessor.py. Enhanced REASONING_PATTERNS to strip checkbox artifacts (- [○], - []: text), stray markdown headers (## [ in ], ## text), and horizontal rules (---). Updated clean_output() to strip Thai and Khmer unconditionally.
errors.prevention: Postprocessor must strip ALL non-Myanmar Unicode script blocks unconditionally. Any script other than Myanmar Unicode (U+1000-U+109F, U+AA60-U+AA7F, U+A9E0-U+A9FF) is forbidden in output.

errors.trigger: Model outputs headings merged with content (e.g., '## ဝိညာဉ်စွမ်းအား"သခင်လေး...') or placeholder headings (e.g., '## အခန်းခေါင်းစဉ်') leak into output
errors.solution: Added fix_merged_headings() to separate headings from content. Added remove_placeholder_headings() to strip placeholder patterns like '## အခန်းခေါင်းစဉ်'. Added remove_checkbox_artifacts() for '- []: [ ]' patterns. All integrated into clean_output() pipeline.
errors.prevention: Postprocessor must detect and fix: (1) Headings without proper newline separation, (2) Template placeholder text in output, (3) Checkbox/list artifacts. Run postprocessor on all output before saving.

errors.trigger: Markdown syntax '## ' and '- ' appears in the middle of paragraphs, breaking the flow. Model hallucinates headings/list items mid-sentence (e.g., '## ရှောင်နန်ဖုန်းဆီသို့...' mid-chapter, '- အကြီးအကဲ စီမံခန့်ခွဲသူ: ...' mid-paragraph)
errors.solution: Added remove_inline_markdown_artifacts() to detect and clean fake markdown: (1) Long ## lines (>80 chars) that aren't proper headings, (2) Long - list items (>60 chars with sentence enders) that are actually paragraph text. Removes the markdown prefix and keeps the content.
errors.prevention: Postprocessor must scan all lines for inline markdown artifacts. Real headings are short, followed by blank lines. Real list items are short and standalone. Long lines with markdown prefixes are hallucinations and should be cleaned.

errors.trigger: When using --chapter-range, the chapter attribute is None, causing TypeError: unsupported format string passed to NoneType.__format__ in _find_chapter_file()
errors.solution: Updated _resolve_workflow() in commands.py to handle chapter=None when chapter_range is set. Extract start chapter from range string (e.g., '5-10' -> 5) for language detection.
errors.prevention: Always check if chapter is None before using chapter-based file resolution. When chapter_range is provided, parse the start chapter from the range for file lookup.

errors.trigger: remove_checkbox_artifacts() regex pattern didn't catch circle symbol (○) inside brackets: '- [○] : content' was not removed
errors.solution: Updated regex in remove_checkbox_artifacts() from '[\sxoX✓✔\-]*' to '[\sxoX✓✔○\-]*' to include the circle symbol (U+25CB) in the character class.
errors.prevention: Checkbox regex patterns must include ALL possible checkbox symbols: empty space, x, X, o, O, checkmarks (✓✔), circles (○●), and dashes.

errors.trigger: AI translation is missing significant content compared to manual translation: (1) Dialogue exchanges truncated or omitted, (2) Incomplete sentences ending with possessive particles (၏), (3) Missing descriptive details and reactions, (4) Flat character voices without emotional markers
errors.solution: Add dialogue preservation rules to translator prompt to ensure ALL dialogue lines are translated. Add incomplete sentence detection to postprocessor. Enhance prompts with descriptive detail requirements and character voice context. Pass character relationship and tone context to translator.
errors.prevention: Prompt must include: 'CRITICAL: Preserve EVERY line of dialogue. Never summarize or skip exchanges.' Postprocessor should detect incomplete sentences (ending with ၏, particles) and flag for re-translation. Add sensory detail requirements to prompts. Pass character context (role, tone, speech patterns) to translator.

errors.trigger: Model outputs bare numerals like '# ၃' followed by '## Title' instead of proper '# အခန်း ၃: Title' format. Postprocessor's fix_chapter_heading_format() didn't handle this pattern.
errors.solution: Update fix_chapter_heading_format() to detect bare numerals (# [Myanmar numeral] or # [Arabic digit]) followed by ## subtitle on separate lines. Convert to '# အခန်း N: Title' format.
errors.prevention: Postprocessor Pattern 3 now handles this case automatically. Added tests to ensure coverage.

errors.trigger: _translate_chunks() called with 2 arguments but method signature only accepts 1. TypeError: TranslationPipeline._translate_chunks() takes 2 positional arguments but 3 were given
errors.solution: Update method signature to accept optional progress_logger parameter: def _translate_chunks(self, chunks: List[str], progress_logger: Optional[Any] = None)
errors.prevention: Always verify method signatures match call sites. Run py_compile and tests after signature changes.

errors.trigger: add_pending_term() called with SQL backend (use_sql=True) but method only handles JSON backend. Empty pending_path ('') gets converted to Path('.'), causing [Errno 21] Is a directory error when trying to read JSON file.
errors.solution: Add SQL backend support to add_pending_term() method. Check self.use_sql flag at start of method and use glossary_repo for database operations instead of FileHandler JSON operations.
errors.prevention: When adding SQL backend support to MemoryManager, ensure ALL methods that read/write glossary/pending files have SQL backend handling. Methods to check: add_pending_term, reject_pending_term, and any other pending-related operations.

errors.trigger: Pipeline times out during chunk translation (FictionEditor too slow) and saves partial output (e.g., 1/18 chunks) as 'completed'. Per-chunk timeout at 900s was too short for 3-stage pipeline with FictionEditor (~20 min per chunk total).
errors.solution: Two fixes: (1) Increase per-chunk timeout from 900s (15 min) to 1800s (30 min). (2) Add partial-completion guard — if len(translated_chunks) < len(chunks) after _translate_chunks(), abort and return error instead of saving partial output.
errors.prevention: Monitor per-chunk total duration. If FictionEditor is enabled, expected per-chunk time is ~20 min. Timeout must be > expected max. Also, pipeline must never save output when not all chunks are completed.

errors.trigger: EXTRACTOR_SYSTEM_PROMPT had format example 'target': 'Myanmar' which LLM interpreted literally. Extracted terms all had target='Myanmar' instead of actual Myanmar translations.
errors.solution: Changed format example to 'target': '<actual_myanmar_translation>' and added rule 5: 'NEVER use the literal English word Myanmar as the target.' Also added defense-in-depth guard in context_updater.py to skip terms with target == 'Myanmar'.
errors.prevention: Prompt format examples must use obviously placeholder values (like '<translation>') not real words. Never use a real language name as a placeholder value in prompt format examples.

errors.trigger: alignment stored cosine similarity (0.65-1.0) in auto_score but RAGRetriever filters auto_score>=min_score(2.5, a 0-5 scale) → most human pairs silently never retrieved
errors.solution: map similarity→quality (min(2.5+sim*2.5,5.0)) at ingestion; backfill existing rows
errors.prevention: keep one documented scale per column; assert range at write

errors.trigger: collection.upsert of >5461 items (chroma 1.x max_batch_size) or embedding tens of thousands at once → crash/OOM
errors.solution: batch encode+upsert at min(client.get_max_batch_size(),2000)
errors.prevention: always chunk bulk Chroma writes

errors.trigger: BGE-M3 1:1 alignment maps a long EN compound sentence to one short MY clause (omission) or unrelated MY (misalignment); similarity alone can't separate near 0.65
errors.solution: rag_pair_quality(): reject length_ratio<0.55, EN>60&ratio>2.6, latin-leak; set usable=0
errors.prevention: length-ratio + latin-leak gate at RAG ingestion

errors.trigger: unescaped ] inside [^...] closes the class early, turning the rest into literals → regex silently matches almost nothing (checker non-Myanmar ratio check)
errors.solution: escape \[ \] inside character classes
errors.prevention: test regex against known positive/negative inputs

errors.trigger: Tibetan ། (U+0F0D) used where Myanmar sentence-ender ။ (U+104B) intended; visually identical → find/replace mismatch in formatter
errors.solution: use Myanmar ။ (U+104B) consistently; verify codepoints
errors.prevention: codepoint-audit Myanmar punctuation in regexes

errors.trigger: global glossary empty because external GLOSSARY_SYSTEM_DB_PATH unset and seed never run → generate-glossary has no global terms
errors.solution: built-in src/db/global_terms_seed.py auto-seeded on empty global set in MemoryManager init
errors.prevention: ship seed data in src; don't depend on an external DB that may not exist

errors.trigger: Glossary web page/API hardcoded novel='wayfarer' which doesn't exist → page shows no terms even though DB has them
errors.solution: _default_novel_slug() picks first novel with terms; novel_slug = request.args.get('novel') or _default_novel_slug()
errors.prevention: Never hardcode a novel slug as a UI default; derive from get_novels()/DB

errors.trigger: _postprocess crashes 'object of type NoneType has no len()' — resume left None placeholder mid translated_chunks (non-contiguous/stale checkpoints), append() didn't fill the hole, partial guard checked len() not content
errors.solution: Fill slot in place: if i<len(translated): translated[i]=chunk else append. Partial guard counts non-None: completed=sum(1 for c in chunks if c is not None)
errors.prevention: When resuming indexed lists, assign by index not append; gate completion on content not length

errors.trigger: 'Could not load query embedding model BAAI/bge-m3' — rag config missing embedding_model → default HF id resolves to interrupted HF cache download (no weights) under local_files_only=True; RAG silently falls back to SQLite
errors.solution: Point config + code defaults to the complete local dir models/bge-m3 (rag.embedding_model + orchestrator/embedder defaults)
errors.prevention: Prefer local model paths over HF repo ids when local_files_only=True; keep one canonical embedding-model path across rag+alignment config

errors.trigger: `opencode run` given a review-only prompt instead edited 26 files, added an unrequested feature, corrupted long_term_memory.json, and introduced 27 ruff errors
errors.solution: Repair JSON (remove orphaned brace/dup key); restore deleted __all__ in re-export __init__; remove dead vars/imports; ruff --fix; validate imports+tests
errors.prevention: Treat external-agent (opencode) edits as untrusted: validate JSON, run ruff+pytest, diff scope vs the prompt before keeping

errors.trigger: Japanese kana (Hiragana U+3040-309F / Katakana U+30A0-30FF, e.g. stray 'い' in a-will-eternal ch.1) leaked into Myanmar output; postprocessor stripped Chinese/Korean/Thai/Khmer/Bengali/Indic but NOT kana
errors.solution: Added JAPANESE_KANA_PATTERN + remove_japanese_kana(); wired into clean_output() and detect_language_leakage() (japanese_chars). Tests in test_postprocessor.py
errors.prevention: Postprocessor must cover ALL non-Myanmar scripts; kana is distinct from CJK ideographs (handled by CHINESE_PATTERN) and needs its own range

errors.trigger: _create_ollama_client read temperature from processing.temperature (0.35) for ALL models, so padauk-gemma:q8_0 ran at 0.35 — above the hard ≤0.2 ceiling that corrupts Myanmar output. The padauk_gemma config block's temperature:0.2 was dead (never read).
errors.solution: Added _effective_temperature(model) clamping padauk-gemma to 0.2 (per-model ceiling _MODEL_MAX_TEMPERATURE); wired into _create_ollama_client. Logs a warning when clamping.
errors.prevention: Enforce documented model hard-limits in code, not just config; config defaults can drift. Verify which config key actually reaches the client at runtime.

errors.trigger: --generate-glossary --from-mm: padauk-gemma returned valid JSON with 8 good terms but dropped the final root '}' (truncated). _balanced_span rejects unbalanced JSON -> all 3 parse attempts fail -> 'No terms found'. Glossary client also ran at default temp 0.5 (unstable, stray glyphs).
errors.solution: Added _close_unbalanced_json() (string-aware bracket-stack repair) as a 4th attempt in extract_json_from_response() and safe_parse_terms(); recovers all 8 terms. Set glossary extraction client temperature to 0.1.
errors.prevention: LLM JSON is frequently truncated by one closing bracket; JSON extraction must repair unbalanced output. Use low temperature for structured-extraction tasks.

errors.trigger: glossary ch1: padauk emitted {""source" (doubled opening key-quote) in every term — balanced JSON but invalid; doubled quotes also corrupt block-extraction string tracking, so repair-on-block failed too. 7 good terms lost.
errors.solution: _repair_json collapses ([{,]\s*)""(?=\w) -> " (key position only, preserves empty strings); added an attempt that repairs the RAW text before block extraction in both parse functions.
errors.prevention: Repair raw text (not just extracted block) for malformations that break string-state tracking; restrict quote-collapse to key positions

errors.trigger: RAG injected 0 examples: (1) alignment_pairs collection uses Chroma default squared-L2 space but retriever computed similarity=1-distance (cosine formula), halving scores so real matches (cos 0.6) fell below min_similarity 0.30; (2) sentence-level corpus vs paragraph-chunk queries makes Chroma weak, and SQLite fallback only ran when Chroma returned EMPTY (never when it returned weak results).
errors.solution: similarity=max(0,1-distance/2) (correct cosine from squared-L2 for normalized vectors, verified 2-2cos). retrieve_similar now falls back to SQLite keyword retrieval when Chroma best < min_similarity. Translator stops re-applying the cosine threshold (would nuke SQLite word-overlap results).
errors.prevention: Match similarity conversion to the collection's distance space; set hnsw:space explicitly. Fallback when primary retriever is weak, not only when empty.

errors.trigger: `--config config/models.padauk.yaml` (a skeleton override) loaded standalone: CLI --config does single-file load (no merge), so it lost settings.yaml's processing section and fell back to Pydantic defaults — repeat_penalty 1.5 (extreme) + chunk_size 800 + RAG off. Result: padauk produced degenerate/empty output -> myanmar_ratio 0.0, all leak counts 0 -> REJECTED -> pipeline aborted.
errors.solution: ProcessingConfig default repeat_penalty 1.5->1.3 (matches every shipped config). Added explicit processing section to models.padauk.yaml (and models.gemma4.yaml) so skeleton configs are correct standalone. Recommend running base settings.yaml + --model/--mode flags (keeps RAG) instead of a skeleton config via --config.
errors.prevention: Defaults must match shipped configs; skeleton/override configs must either be merged or carry their own processing section. Model works in isolation -> suspect config/sampling, not the model.

errors.trigger: full/lite/two_stage: chunks translate fine (avg quality 96) but final file is just the heading (char_count 36, 'Content loss: 25% coverage'). clean_output's heading-injection block searched for '# အခန်း N' ANYWHERE and did text=lines[heading_end:], deleting every line BEFORE it. The model hallucinated a heading in the last chunk, so all prior chunks were wiped. Likely a major driver of the documented 'full pipeline drops 41-91% of content'.
errors.solution: Only strip a LEADING heading block (first non-empty line). Remove other '# အခန်း N' headings hallucinated mid-body in place, never cutting surrounding content. Verified: 2248->2245 chars recovered.
errors.prevention: Never use a hallucinated marker found anywhere as a slice/cut point; restrict structural strips to document start. Compare per-chunk checkpoints vs final to catch assembly-stage content loss.

errors.trigger: use_reflection=true -> ReflectionAgent called model 'qwen:7b' (404 not found). reflection_agent.py read self.config.get('reflection_model','qwen:7b') from the TOP level, but reflection_model is nested under translation_pipeline -> lookup missed -> defaulted to uninstalled qwen:7b, overriding the padauk refiner client (model=self.model at the chat call).
errors.solution: Resolve reflection_model from translation_pipeline (then legacy top-level), falling back to models.refiner/translator, then padauk-gemma. Same for reflection_temperature. Now uses the installed padauk model.
errors.prevention: Read nested config keys from their real path; default agent models to an already-loaded model (refiner/translator), never a hardcoded model that may not be installed.

errors.trigger: translate_file: progress_logger=None was set INSIDE the try, after FileHandler.read_text. A read failure -> except handlers hit `if progress_logger:` -> UnboundLocalError, masking the real exception.
errors.solution: Bind progress_logger=None BEFORE the try block.
errors.prevention: Any name referenced in an except handler must be bound before the try.

errors.trigger: config/loader.py: yaml.safe_load(open(path)) without a context manager leaks the file handle.
errors.solution: Use `with open(path) as f: yaml.safe_load(f)`.
errors.prevention: Always open files via a with-statement.
